messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE P0 - model-serving alerts: sudden spike in malformed token outputs for model 'redwood-v3a' in us-west1. Error rate ~18% across routed hosts, several customers reporting garbled completions. Traces: https://internal-redwood/infra/incidents/1754321988
oncall-alex: ack, I'm on it. Paged SRE and Eng-ML.
eng-ml-sam: quick summary from canary logs — weightset ws-2024-05-12-9f3a was promoted but SHA doesn't match manifest. Runtime reports tokenizer=vocab_v2.1 while artifact metadata expects vocab_v2.3.
eng-runtime-lina: confirmed on runtime side: tokenizer init throws mismatch exceptions on ~30% of hosts, KV cache warm fails. Canary began failing at ~11:03 UTC; looks like promo pipeline progressed despite canary failures (featureflag rollout continued).
prod-ops-raj: can we flip the rollout flag immediately? I can do it on approval.
release-manager-maya: flipping feature flag now -> FLAG:model_promo_live = false 
release-manager-maya: command used: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' https://flags.internal/api/flag/model_promo_live -d '{"value":false}'
incident-bot: Feature flag flip recorded (actor: release-manager-maya) at 11:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
sre-jordan: starting live rollback to previous weightset ws-2024-05-10-4b2c and will remove promoted alias. Running rollback via deploy agent.
sre-jordan: ```
/usr/local/bin/deploy-agent rollback --model redwood-v3a --weightset ws-2024-05-10-4b2c --timeout 600
```
eng-ml-sam: pushing tokenizer v2.3 to canary hosts and re-verifying artifact hashes (sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeef...). Adding sample failing traces to the incident ticket.
eng-runtime-lina: prechecks show healthy on 50% of hosts after rollback start; continuing progressive rollback and cache flush. Watching latency, p95 and error rates.
customer-success-zoe: drafting external note for impacted customers: "We observed a short period of degraded output quality for some requests to the redwood-v3a model. We rolled back the recent promotion and outputs are back to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with details and mitigations."
prod-ops-raj: rough impact window estimated 11:03 - 11:18 UTC (~15m). Roughly 22 customers had requests routed to affected canary hosts.
oncall-alex: handing off to eng-sre for post-incident follow-up — @sre-jordan please own the follow-up/RCAs.
sre-jordan: taking ownership. Creating incident ticket INC-2024-0652, collecting deploy logs, promo pipeline traces, and sample garbled outputs. Initial hypothesis: artifact promotion allowed a weightset alias without updated tokenizer metadata, causing runtime-tokenizer mismatch during init.
eng-ml-sam: adding eval logs, failed tokenization samples, and the artifact registry state to the ticket. Will include a small repro for infra to validate.
incident-bot: All paged responders acknowledged. Escalation cleared.
customer-success-zoe: will send customer notification after we have an RCA draft and planned mitigations.
eng-runtime-lina: monitoring: error rate returned to baseline at ~11:20 UTC. Rolling state shows stable. Closing on-call mitigation actions. :tada:
oncall-alex: thanks everyone. Postmortem assigned; please add timeline, root cause, and action items. I'll summarize in #postmortems within 24h.
